name: Kalinga University Engineering

about.text: Located in the New Raipur, Kalinga University is quickly growing and offering quality education and a great learning environment. With a green and modern campus, the university helps students grow both academically and individually. Kalinga University focuses on the overall development of its students and prepares them to succeed in their careers and life.

All courses at Kalinga University are recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC), All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE), which means they are accepted in India. The university is also approved by the UGC-DEB, which makes its online and flexible courses valid and valuable in the job market.

Kalinga University also offers flexible timing programs, which are perfect for working professionals and others who need to study at their own pace. However, all students must come to campus for offline exams, even for flexible programs, as per the instructions of the concerned regulatory bodies. These programs include:
Access to a powerful online learning platform
Optional practical sessions and doubt-clearing classes on campus
The university offers 3 specializations so that learners can choose the best program according to their interests, such as:
Above mentioned specializations include the latest topics like Artificial Intelligence, Machine learning, and emerging technologies.

aboutBoxes.title: Online Degree Acceptance
aboutBoxes.content: Online degrees earned from a government-approved university, just like a regular degree, are accepted by the top recruiters worldwide including government & private sectors.

aboutBoxes.title: Value of Online Degree
aboutBoxes.content: An online degree from a government-approved university holds similar recognition in the industry as that of a regular degree. Thus, it is equally valuable when considered for a job or higher education.

aboutBoxes.title: Quality of Education
aboutBoxes.content: The quality of education offered in online programs is of the same standard as offered in an on-campus program. Be it curriculum, faculty members, evaluation methods, practical sessions, online & on-campus programs follow similar standards of quality.

facts: The university offers UGC and AICTE-approved engineering programs that ensure quality education and recognition.
The university has have team of Experienced faculty bringing both academic knowledge and industry expertise.
The university has such Specializations available in Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, and other fields.
The university has the best curriculum focusing on emerging technologies like AI and Data Science.
The university has tie-ups with Strong industry, which provide valuable internships and placement opportunities.
The university places a deep Emphasis on practical learning and fosters project-based education.
The university mainly focuses on Regular tech fests, workshops, and seminars to promote continuous learning.
The university helps to provide the best Placement support and career guidance services help students in their career paths.

emi.text: Education loans are available from various financial institutions with varying interest rates and repayment periods.

admission.text: Step 1: Students must register on the university's official website by paying the online registration fee through the university's admission portal.
Step 2: After registration, upload the necessary documents to the admission portal. These documents will be verified by the university's admissions committee within 48 hours.

Step 3: After the Post document verification, the admissions office will either send a link to pay the course fee to the shortlisted candidates, and then students can directly pay it via the university’s payment gateway.
Step 4: After the successful fee payment, students will receive access to the Learning Management System and all details of academic resources to begin their engineering program.

Note: Interested candidates can connect with the university’s online counselors for personalized guidance, which will help them to understand their selected course better and explore Kalinga University’s academic standing and industry relevance, and known for its excellence.

examination.text: For regular and online flexible programs for working professionals exams, students have to visit the university for the offline exams. As per the instructions of the regulatory bodies, applicants have to visit the campus for examination. In addition to that, internal assignments, projects, lab work, and offline exams are all part of the final evaluation scheme for your flexible timing engineering diploma or degree program.

placementText.text: Students are guided by the faculty to start their careers via placement support. Kalinga University has a dedicated Training and Placement Department that actively works with students to secure placements in various companies. Some of the top recruiters for B.Tech students at Kalinga University include Tata Motors, Amul, Patanjali, Global Logic, SAIL, and NTPC, among others.
Strong industry connections with companies like NTPC, Hindustan Unilever, and Tata Chemicals.
